description: Blocks mail FROM any domain under these abused TLDs (*.TLD sender entries; Microsoft marks it high confidence phishing and quarantines it). WARNING: a sender block also blocks OUTBOUND mail - users cannot send to these TLDs either (NDR 550 5.7.703), and the whole message is rejected for every recipient if one recipient matches. Block entries beat allow entries, so a per-sender allow does NOT create an exception. Run ListTldExposure first. Aspendora fork addition (Vikunja CIPP-30).
notes: CIPP-30 abused-TLD block. Also blocks OUTBOUND mail to this TLD.
